2608.20810.title: When Generated Images Look Right and Retrieve Wrong: Coverage-Guided Cross-Scale Re-Indexing for Knowledge-Faithful Generative Perception
2608.20810.paper_summary: Multimodal information systems increasingly route generated visual content back through the same vision-language index that informed its production, so the output must remain retrievable by the queries it was meant to serve. When the scene contains entities at vastly different scales, existing language-guided generators condition on a single, globally pooled text embedding and quietly drop scale-specific concepts, breaking concept-query retrieval even when pixel fidelity is high. We formalise this failure as semantic collapse and propose CERES, a closed-loop multimodal indexing framework that builds a three-level semantic pyramid, mines implicit concepts via a co-occurrence-aware router, performs scale-routed cross-attention into a lightweight U-Net generator, and verifies coverage by re-indexing the generated image with the same frozen VLM. A continuously differentiable soft-Jaccard coverage objective returns dense gradients to the 0.39M-parameter generator under explicit non-degeneracy conditions, and coverage is verified by an independent DINOv2 linear probe trained only on external scene and object labels. On four pansharpening benchmarks across seven settings, CERES delivers the new state of the art with the largest gains where scale variation is most extreme. It also improves concept-query retrieval Recall@5 by +14.0 points and image-text mean reciprocal rank by 0.19 over the strongest baseline, showing that the closed loop preserves queryable content rather than self-referential feature consistency.
2608.20810.paper_summary_zh: 多模態信息系統越來越多地將生成的視覺內容通過同一個視覺-語言索引回饋，該索引為其生成提供了信息，因此輸出必須能夠被其原本旨在服務的查詢檢索。當場景中包含不同尺度的實體時，現有的語言引導生成器依賴於單一的、全局池化的文本嵌入，並靜默地丟棄特定尺度的概念，即使在像素保真度高的情況下，也會破壞概念-查詢檢索。我們將這一失敗形式化為語義崩潰，並提出CERES，一個封閉循環的多模態索引框架，該框架構建了一個三層語義金字塔，通過一個考慮共現的路由器挖掘隱含概念，對輕量級U-Net生成器進行尺度導向的交叉注意，並通過用相同的凍結VLM重新索引生成的圖像來驗證覆蓋範圍。在明確的非退化條件下，連續可微的soft-Jaccard覆蓋目標為擁有0.39M參數的生成器返回密集梯度，覆蓋範圍則由一個僅在外部場景和物體標籤上訓練的獨立DINOv2線性探針進行驗證。在七個設置的四個全色增強基準上，CERES在尺度變化最極端的地方提供了新的最先進技術，並實現了最大的增益。它還將概念-查詢檢索的Recall@5提高了14.0個點，將圖像-文本的平均倒數排名提高了0.19，顯示出封閉循環保留了可查詢的內容，而不是自參考特徵的一致性。
